title: The Visconti Italian cipher, Brussels-London 1727, BL Add MS 32270 f. 42 (DECODE R7931)

documents.shelfmark: BL Add MS 32270 f. 42; DECODE R7931
documents.route: Deciphering Branch key for Count Visconti (Brussels) <-> Marquis Visconti (London)

plaintext.source: No ciphertext on the leaf: it is a reconstructed key table with an English endorsement.

transcription.notes: 193 filled places of 300 transcribed to key_f42.tsv; counted with grep over the file. Unit = filled key places.

system.summary: Numerical nomenclator of 300 places: single letters with homophones, doubled letters, CV syllables and about 50 names and words (Walpole, Townshend, Sinzendorff, Ostenda, Congresso...), as reconstructed by the Deciphering Branch.
system.sibling_key: R7932 (working draft of the same key); R7933 (French key, same parties)
system.notes: The record is the key itself; no ciphertext in this cipher is bound in Add MS 32270.

prior_solution.where: The leaf is the Deciphering Branch's own 1727 reconstruction of the key; DECODE typed it as a ciphertext.

conditions.human_role: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login and passed its session cookie to the model, posed the target with /goal from the catalogue. No target-specific intervention.

solution.what: Listed every DECODE record at Add MS 32270 from the harvested list: all are keys except R7927, R7929, R7930, R7931; R7932 and R7933 are Visconti keys on the next leaves.
Fetched R7931, R7932, R7933 images with the stored DECODE cookie.

Recognised R7931 as a fair-copy key table (1-300) endorsed 'Count Visconti at Bruxelles with Marq.s Visconti here 1727 Italian Cypher', not a letter; R7932 its working draft; R7933 a French key for the same parties.
Transcribed the 193 filled places of f. 42 to key_f42.tsv.

outcome.method_basis: DECODE R7931 (BL Add MS 32270 f. 42) is the Deciphering Branch's fair-copy key table for the Visconti Italian cipher of 1727, mistyped as a ciphertext; there is no message on the leaf.
outcome.notes: Catalogued ciphertext is a key table (the solution, not a message); nothing to decipher. 33 'Rialso' and 172 'Reggenza' doubtful readings.
